description:
Get one product's collection: what was captured (coverageLabel, coverage, captureNote) and
every screen, grouped into flow, marketing and product, one line each (id, title, primary
pattern, page url). detail=full adds each screen's notes and tags. Use it to explore a
competitor's whole UI; then get_screen_image on the screens you will build from, and
get_design to match its look.

detail.description: full adds each screen's notes and tags.

productId.description: Product id from list_products, e.g. linear, stripe or airbnb.

name: get_product
title: Get one product
